privacy_meta_desc: Privacy Policy for My Weather Pal: private local weather, AI watercolor generation, on-device IndexedDB storage, and Google Play Data Safety.
privacy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how My Weather Pal (Android package co.median.android.odeqrey and web application, "the App", "we", "us") handles information. We are committed to private-by-default software: no mandatory accounts, no surveillance, and transparent on-device storage.
privacy_s1_body: You can use all features of My Weather Pal without signing up, logging in, or providing personal details such as your name, email address, phone number, or social logins.
privacy_s2_body: When you tap the location button, the App requests your device's GPS coordinates (approximate or precise) solely to fetch live local forecasts, air quality indices, and disaster alerts for your area:
privacy_s2_item1: Location is only accessed when you explicitly tap the GPS button. You can always choose to search for a city manually instead.
privacy_s2_item2: Coordinates are resolved to a readable place name using the privacy-focused Photon (OpenStreetMap) service.
privacy_s2_item3: We do not log your movement, record travel history, or store GPS coordinates on our servers. Requests are sent directly from your device to the weather data providers.
privacy_s2_item4: You can revoke location access at any time in your Android device settings (Settings → Apps → My Weather Pal → Permissions) or browser settings.
privacy_s3_body: My Weather Pal features an AI Watercolor Gallery that displays city landmark art, allows generating custom watercolor scenes, and supports personal background photos:
privacy_s3_item1: When you describe a custom watercolor scene, the text prompt and city name are transmitted securely over HTTPS to synthesize the artwork. These prompts are ephemeral, not linked to any user identity, and not used to build personal profiles.
privacy_s3_item2: If you select a photo from your camera or photo library as a custom background, the image is compressed and processed entirely on-device using an off-screen HTML canvas. Your photos are never uploaded to our servers or any cloud storage.
privacy_s3_item3: All created watercolor scenes and uploaded background photos are stored exclusively on your device inside an on-device database (WeatherPalArtDB). They never leave your device.
privacy_s3_item4: For select cities, public landmark photographs are loaded from Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons to illustrate local culture. No personal data is sent during these image fetches.
privacy_s4_body: The App uses on-device browser storage (localStorage and IndexedDB) to preserve your preferences between sessions and enable offline functionality:
privacy_s4_item2: Measurement units (°C / °F, km/h / mph) and text size preferences (weather:units, weather:font-size).
privacy_s4_item3: Sky background themes and clothing occasion filters (weather:sky-pref, weather:wear-category).
privacy_s4_item5: Cached weather forecasts for instant loading and offline viewing.
privacy_s4_item6: Your custom artwork collection and city background assignments in IndexedDB.
privacy_s4_footer: This data never leaves your device. You can erase all stored data at any time by clearing App storage in Android Settings or clearing browser site data.
privacy_s5_body: To deliver real-time weather, warnings, artwork, and app functionality, the App interacts with these services:
privacy_s5_openmeteo: Hourly/7-day weather forecasts, air quality (AQI), UV index, and river flood advisories.
privacy_s5_photon: City name search and GPS reverse-geocoding.
privacy_s5_tmd: Official weather warnings and monsoon bulletins for Thailand.
privacy_s5_google_play: Handles secure purchases of supporter tiers on the Android app without exposing your card details to us.
privacy_s5_admob: Used exclusively to deliver optional, user-initiated rewarded video ads (for example, unlocking a temporary 24-hour gallery slot). For details, consult Google's Advertising Privacy Policy.
privacy_s5_median: The native application shell packaging the web experience for Android devices.
privacy_s6_item1: We do not sell, rent, broker, or monetize your personal data.
privacy_s6_item2: We do not track you across other apps or websites for targeted advertising.
privacy_s6_item3: We do not access your address book, microphone, contacts, or calendar.
privacy_s6_item4: We do not transmit personal photos from your device to any cloud server.
privacy_s7_body: Because we do not operate a centralized database or store user accounts, we do not retain identifiable personal records. You retain complete authority over your data:
privacy_s7_item1: Clear App storage or browser cache to wipe all saved cities, settings, and paintings immediately.
privacy_s7_item2: Disable Location access anytime in Android device settings.
privacy_s7_item3: Removing the App completely removes all local data files created by the App.
privacy_s8_body: My Weather Pal is a general-audience utility designed to be safe for all ages. We do not knowingly collect, solicit, or store personal information from children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in the European Union), in full compliance with COPPA and GDPR.
privacy_s9_body: We may occasionally update this Privacy Policy as new features or data providers are integrated. Any changes will be published directly on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
privacy_s10_body: My Weather Pal is built to be private by default. Your cities, settings, and artwork stay on your device, so there is no account to delete and no personal record to request.
